land_area_metric.name: land_area_sq_miles
land_area_metric.rule: carry forward unless concrete land event changes it; Round 65 adds 0.125 sq mi after a fresh survey of the newly seized final-refuge tract

special_event_policy.rule: Special is a core event category. Every round performs one independent random Special-event roll using the base probability. Success adds one Special event to the ordinary round event set; failure adds none. There is no candidate-selection, raw-success, or accepted-candidate stage.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_policy: tracked separately only when required; it is not part of Special-event selection.

continuity.campaign_development: 7 April 57 BCE: Valerius renews the household's established inspection and conduct protocols, instructing his men to uphold them while treating local residents respectfully. He sends the final completely detailed, chronologically labeled, and confirmed dossier concerning the raid inquiry through the established Roman correspondence, and receipt is acknowledged.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 sq mi; Round 42 adds 0.25; Round 55 establishes 7.0625 after measuring the earlier former-bandit aggregate; Round 59 adds 0.50 to reach 7.5625; Round 65 surveys the newly seized final-refuge tract at 0.125 sq mi, bringing holdings to 7.6875; Round 75 adds 0.0625 sq mi (40 acres) through a documented purchase of the disputed tract, bringing total holdings to 7.75 sq mi.

character_registry.rule: Recurring named characters are persistent simulation entities. Established characters must be considered during every round and reused by name when contextually involved. Generic labels may be used only for genuinely unidentified groups or when no named individual is supported by prior continuity.

characters.name: Quintus Caecilius Metellus Celer
characters.continuity: persisted relationship; may appear when contextually relevant

characters.continuity: persisted relationship; may appear when contextually relevant

event_variety_policy.rule: Do not make every event about the same subject. Prefer distinct news dimensions supported by current state: military operations, intelligence, logistics, political relationships, economic/property activity, social/local developments, personal developments, geography, and reactions. Variety must arise from simulation context and must not be fabricated solely to fill slots.

exact_quantity_rule: Exact quantities retain their explicit units and are not converted into condition points. Financial effects are represented through ai_ledger.financial_realization and account balances, not a currency metric.

financial_policy.rule: Economic activity need not explicitly mention income. Realized financial effects are intermittent consequences recorded in the ledger when the event provides a concrete basis.

account_routing.treasury: state, military, public-command, or explicitly public/state funds
account_routing.private_account: Valerius private wealth and established private transfers
account_routing.financial_realization: event-level financial effects recorded inside ai_ledger.financial_realization

financial_policy.double_counting_rule: Transfers between accounts are not new income; gross receipts, costs, net public profit, private transfers, principal, and realized returns remain distinct.
financial_policy.historical_reconciliation: Documented past financial blocks remain canonical. Missing historical income is not fabricated. Legacy currency_units are interpreted as denarii while source uncertainty is preserved.

canonical_pointer_policy.rule: The canonical round is determined by synchronized scenario/state/round records, never by the newest-looking file, filename, search result, or legacy schema record.

legacy_round_records.round-014.json: historical record; never a latest-round pointer
legacy_round_records.round-052.json: historical legacy-schema record; never a latest-round pointer

canonical_pointer_policy.artifact_exclusion_rule: Historical or legacy records may remain for audit but cannot override the synchronized canonical pointer.
